source.subject: test(browser): restore fact review and scoped visit receipts

baseline.root_cause: The selector requires a heading inside the job button; SelectableCard renders the title in span.job-card-title and names the button using company/title spans.
baseline.product_assertions_reached_before_failur: Fact edit/reset and persisted pending-state checks were reached. The failing job-selection step preceded document preparation and downstream download assertions.

repair.change: Scope the job lookup to .job-list and use the button's exact company-plus-title accessible name. After activation, assert the selected detail's expected title heading and direct company eyebrow.
preserved_real_document_assertions: Each text/source/kind edit resets verification and approval and persists the pending state across profile reload.
Verification alone does not make an unapproved edited fact eligible; explicit approval is still required.
Preparation continues through the real operation worker and checks generated document fact IDs.
TXT, DOCX and PDF downloads retain content inclusion/exclusion assertions for eligible and ineligible fact text.
Current and historical document identity/checksum assertions remain intact.
preserved_safety_and_fixture_oracles: Existing strict locator behavior and timeouts.
No .first(), broad regex, new retry, skip or assertion removal.
The other two demo-navigation methods remain unchanged.

changes: Replace the stale button-containing-heading lookup with the .job-list button's exact company-plus-title accessible name.
After activation, assert the selected detail has the expected visible title heading and the direct company eyebrow text.
source_basis: SelectableCard explicitly uses aria-labelledby for company and title spans; badge/summary/footer are aria-describedby and do not change the accessible name.
main.tsx renders the selected detail as section.job-detail with direct span.eyebrow company and h2 title.
The same job-list accessible-name pattern already exists in test_uploaded_resume_comparison.py.
preserved: All existing timeouts and strict locator behavior; no .first(), broad regex, retry, skip or assertion removal.
All fact edit/reset, persisted approval, reapproval and profile version checks.
The real preparation operation worker and generated fact-id checks.
TXT/DOCX/PDF content inclusion/exclusion and checksum assertions.
Historical document identity/checksum assertions and local-only request gate.
Other two demo-navigation methods remain unchanged.

verification.reason: Known cloud browser startup restriction; parent plans one existing hosted browser workflow at the eventual exact candidate.

limits: This static patch review does not establish downstream browser success.
Fixture repair protects MJ-REQ-092/#93, which is already PASS; it does not add to original acceptance count.
The earlier 078/110 proofs remain explicitly tested at 971 and are not relabeled as new-main execution.
